content:
nora (Marketing): Quick sync 1: I sketched a compact enterprise one-pager for the launch: 'Inference Deployments 100: enterprise quickpack'. Looking for quick approvals so we can add it to the webinar resources.

eli (Growth): Drop the draft pls. Want to attach it to the webinar email and the gated landing.

nora (Marketing): https://redwood.example/s/ep-deploy-quickpack (preview). Single page, 3 columns for Hosted / Dedicated / Private, headline benefit bullets, 2 CTAs: 'Get readiness kit' + 'Schedule 15m'.

tori (Product): Copy note: make SLA phrasing absolute-light: Hosted: 99.9% uptime (best-effort for free tier), Dedicated: 99.95% with reserved pools, Private: SLA per contract. Latency guidance: Hosted median ~40ms (small convo), Dedicated median ~25-40ms depending on instance. Add footnote: "benchmarks are workload-dependent".

ben (Field): Please add a one-line routing cue for reps: "Inbound flows: readiness-kit -> solutions queue; schedule -> growth SDRs." Also add a sample SOC response template.

zoe (Design): Quick Qs: 1) Badge colors? 2) Do we want a 2-up variant for mobile? 3) Iconography style (outline vs filled)?

nora (Marketing): 1) badges: Hosted = lime, Dedicated = cyan, Private = indigo. 2) yes please 2-up for mobile. 3) outline icons. Keep file <300KB.

alex (Demand): For the landing snippet, can we add a single benchmark line under Dedicated: "p95 latency ~120ms on long-context QA (internal lab)", marked with an asterisk. That helps conversion for performance-conscious buyers.

tori (Product): OK but mark internal and add the footnote: "*lab conditions; actuals vary by model and prompt length."

vic (PMM): For messaging iteration let's A/B test copy for the readiness CTA: Variant A "Get enterprise readiness kit" vs Variant B "Request SLA & security checklist". We'll route clicks differently. Add UTMs.

ell (sic) eli (Growth): Routing: map UTM param campaign=ep_quickpack, content={variant}. Webhook mapping: readiness -> tag=readiness_pack_ep, schedule -> tag=demo_ep_15. I can add mapping in the playbook.

ben (Field): Add micro-FAQ: "Will Redwood support private models?" Answer: "Yes. Open models and private uploads supported; recommend Dedicated pilot before Private onboarding."

nora (Marketing): Plan: Zoe updates asset, Tori signs SLA + footnote, Vic sets up A/B test plan, Eli wires the webhook/UTMs, Alex drafts landing copy. Target publish: Wednesday AM prior to webinar.

zoe (Design): I'll produce SVG + two PNG sizes and a compressed mobile JPG. Filenames: ep_deploy_quickpack_v1.{svg,png,jpg}. I added alt copy and a 1-line rep note in the asset.

alex (Demand): Drafted landing and email snippets. Short email subject: "Webinar: Selecting the right inference deployment for your stack" Long subject line: "Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private: what to choose for latency, cost, and compliance"

tori (Product): Add one compliance line: "Integrations: KMS, audit logging, and SOC2 controls available; contract-level controls for Private."

vic (PMM): I'll configure the A/B test in the playbook and include success metric: readiness kit CTR and demo-scheduled rate.

eli (Growth): Also add tiny UTM template in the asset notes: "?utm_source=field&utm_campaign=ep_quickpack&utm_medium=onepager&utm_content={variant}"

ben (Field): I'll prepare the sample SOC email and SDR routing doc and drop in #sales-playbooks after assets are live.

nora (Marketing): Uploaded new files to assets: https://redwood.example/s/ep-deploy-quickpack/v1 (ep_deploy_quickpack_v1.svg + png/jpg). Updated copy with conservative SLAs and bench footnote.

zoe (Design): Confirmed. I also added a small section with recommended Slack responses for SOC inquiries.

vic (PMM): A/B plan posted to /marketing/experiments/ep_quickpack_ab. Will share results in 2 weeks.

alex (Demand): Landing draft uploaded to /marketing/webinar/ep_quickpack (includes benchmark asterisk).

ben (Field): Routing doc in #sales-playbooks. Webhook mappings look good.

nora (Marketing): Excellent. Final call: any copy tweaks before Tue 5pm? If not, we go live Wed AM.

eli (Growth): :thumbsup:

nora (Marketing): Thanks all, archiving this thread and spinning follow-ups into the webinar creative and A/B test threads.
